text_block_list.text:
After the Kikuka-sho, Agnes Tachyon 
confesses to her Trainer that her legs 
were in such a state that they could have 
given out at any moment.

If she couldn't reach the "Edge of 
Possibility" with her own legs, she had no 
choice but to entrust that potential to 
another Umamusume. With that thought, she 
passed her dream onto someone else.

Struck by her Trainer's genuine feelings, 
she resolved to fulfill her dream with her 
own legs and conquered her weakness.

Upon learning that Agnes Tachyon had been 
fighting all alone, her Trainer pledged 
full cooperation. And so, once again—

The days of striving together toward "the 
far reaches of Umamusume potential" had 
begun. Their first goal was the upcoming 
GⅠ race, the Osaka Hai.
